questions.question: A person can row a yacht along the stream at a speed of 9 km/h and against the stream at a speed of 7 km/h. The speed of the stream is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

B + C = 9 ------(1)

B - C = 7 ------(2)

Subtract equation (2) from (1)

2C = 2

C = 1 km/h

**∴ Speed of the stream is 1 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Speed of the yacht along the stream = 9 km/h

Speed of the yacht against the stream = 7 km/h

**Concept used:**

Speed of the Boat along the stream = B + C

Speed of the Boat against the stream = B - C

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of yacht and stream be B and C respectively

Speed of the yacht along the stream = B + C = 9 ------(1)

Speed of the yacht against the stream = B - C = 7 ------(2)

Subtract equation (2) from (1)

2C = 2

C = 1 km/h

∴ The speed of the stream is 1 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of 5 ÷ [6 of 2 + (3 × 7 ÷ (5 of 3))].
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 ÷ [6 of 2 + {3 × 7 ÷ (5 of 3)}].

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/XyaV31Q-h8zBJh5-7QVhYtsb6qFig09uzisfKOhCv-fuRzTOYZC5Dsr1pY2GNg7h0xdxrNcu3j1r3eKzt1uZ3rJPS6pOrDotwtyMiCaiVAfB_uvtoPk8PEkA4GNAySB4Zm3LM9rJjv5VqiZ7sTdyPA] 

**Calculation:**

5 ÷ [6 x 2 + (3 x 7 ÷ (5 x 3))]

⇒ 5 ÷ [12 + (3 x 7 ÷ 15)]

⇒ 5 ÷ [12 + (3 x 7/15)]

⇒ 5 ÷ [12 + 7/5]

⇒ 5 ÷ [67/5]

⇒ 5 x 5/67

⇒ 25/67

**∴ Required value is 25/67.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers 25% discount on the Marked Price Another shopkeeper offers three successive discounts of 5%, 12% and 10% on the same Marked Price. The difference between the discounts given by two shopkeepers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If successive discount is a% and b% then equivalent discount 

⇒ a + b - (a x b)/100

Three successive discounts are 5%, 12%, and 10%

Equivalent of 5% and 12% = 5 + 12 - (5 x 12)/100 = 16.4%

Equivalent of 16.4% and 10% = 16.4 + 10 - (16.4 x 10)/100 = 24.76%

The difference between the discounts = 25% - 24.76% = 0.24%

**∴ The difference between the discounts is 0.24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Single discount offered = 25%

Another successive discounts = 5%, 12% and 10%

**Concept used:**

SP = MP x (100 - Discount%)/100

Discount% = [(MP - SP)/MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let MP = ₹100

SP at successive discounts = 100 × (95)/(100) × (88)/(100) × (90)/(100) = ₹75.24

Discount% = [(100 - 75.24)/100] × 100 = 24.76%

Difference between single discount and successive discounts

⇒ 25% - 24.76% = 0.24%

∴ The difference between the discount is 0.24%

questions.question: There is a number greater than 1 which when divided by 4, 5 and 6 leaves the same remainder 3 in each case. Find the largest number, smaller than 500 which satisfies the given condition.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

LCM of 4, 5, and 6 = 60

The required number is in the form o (60k +3) and less than 500

⇒ 500 ÷ 60

Here, Quotient = 8 and Remainder = 20

⇒ 480 is the largest number, smaller than 500 which is divisible by 60

Required number = (60 × 8) + 3 = 483

**∴ The required number is 483.**

questions.question: A vendor bought candies at 12 for ₹20 and sold them at 6 for ₹12. Find his percentage gain or loss.
questions.solution:

CP of 12 candies = ₹20

SP of 6 candies = ₹12

Profit% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

**2**. Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time(in years)

⇒ SI in 4 year = ₹3900

⇒ SI in 3 year = 3900 x 3/4 = ₹2925

Now, P = 17925 - 2925 = ₹15000

⇒ 2925 = (15000 × 3 × R)/100

⇒ R = 6.5%

⇒ 2R = 13%

According to the question,

SI = (18500 x 22 x 13)/(5 x 100)

⇒ SI = ₹10,582

**∴ The required SI is ₹10,582.**

questions.question: If X and Y together can complete a work in 10 days, Y and Z can complete the work in 12 days, and Z and X can complete the work in 15 days, then X alone will complete the work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X and Y can complete the work in 10 days

Y and Z can complete the work in 12 days

Z and X can complete the work in 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let total work be 60 units (LCM of 10, 12, 15)

⇒ Efficiency of (X + Y) = 60/10 = 6 ------(1)

⇒ Efficiency of (Y + Z) = 60/12 = 5 ------(2)

⇒ Efficiency of (X + Z) = 60/15 = 4 ------(3)

Equation(1) + Equation(2) + Equation(3)

⇒ 2(X + Y + Z) = 15

⇒ X + Y + Z = 15/2 ------(4)

Equation(4) - Equation(2)

⇒ X = 15/2 - 5 = 5/2

A alone will complete the work = 60 × 2/5 = 24 days

∴ A alone will complete the work in 24 days.

questions.question: The average of ten consecutive odd numbers is 46. The average of smallest and the greatest number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of ten consecutive odd numbers is 46

**Formula used:** 

Average = (Sum of Observations)/(Total Number of Observations) 

**Calculation:**

Let the 10 consecutive odd numbers be a, (a + 2), (a + 4), (a + 6), (a + 8), (a + 10), (a + 12), (a + 14), (a + 16) and (a + 18)

Sum of odd numbers = 10a + 90

According to the question,

10a + 90 = 46 × 10

⇒ 10a = 460 - 90

⇒ a = 37

Greatest number = 37 + 18 = 55

Average of the smallest and the greatest number

⇒ (37 + 55)/2 = 46

**∴ The average of the smallest and the greatest number is 46.**

questions.question: If P can complete { {1} over 3} of a work in 6 days and Q can complete {{1} over 4} of the same work in 9 days, how much will Q get if both work together and are paid in advance ₹210 in all?

questions.question: Divide ₹12,100 into 2 parts such that when these are invested for 3 and 4 years, respectively, at the rate of 6% per annum simple interest, the amounts received are equal. What is 75% of the difference between the two parts (in ₹ )?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Total Money = ₹12,100

Rate = 6%

Time = 3 years and 4 years

**Formula used:**

**1**. SI = (PRT)/100

**2**. Amount = SI + P

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time (in years)

**Calculation:**

Let the two parts be A and B respectively

According to the question,

A + (A×6×3)/(100) = B + (B×6×4)/(100)

⇒ (118A)/(100) = (124B)/(100)

⇒ (A)/(B) = (62)/(59)

Total Money = 62 + 59 = 121 units

Again, according to the question,

121 units = ₹12,100

⇒ 1 unit = ₹100

⇒ A = 62 units = ₹6200

⇒ B = 59 units = ₹5900

75% of the difference between the two parts

⇒ (6200 - 5900) × 75/100

⇒ (300) x 3/4 = 225

**∴ 75% of the difference between the two parts is ₹225.**

questions.question: A man goes to his office from his house at a speed of 4 km/h and returns at a speed of 2 km/h. If he takes 6 hours in going and coming, what is the distance between his house and office?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If the distance of both directions is the same and the speed of one direction is a km/h and the speed of returning is b km/h

Average Speed = 2ab/(a + b)

Total distance for both direction = Avg Speed × Total Time

Total distance for both direction = frac {2 × 4 × 2}{4 + 2} × 6 = 16 km

Distance between house and office in one way = 16/2 = 8 km

**∴ The distance between the house and the office is 8 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed while going to office = 4 km/h 

Speed while returning from office = 2 km/h

Total time = 6 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between the office and the house be d km

According to the question,

⇒ d/4 + d/2 = 6

⇒ d + 2d = 6 × 4

⇒ 3d = 24

⇒ d = 8 km

**∴ The distance between the house and the office is 8 km.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 342 and their HCF is 19. How many pairs of such numbers can be formed?
questions.solution:

The sum of two numbers = 342

HCF = 19

**Concept Used:**

Two numbers are said to be co-prime when their HCF is 1

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be 19a and 19b respectively

Where a and b are co-prime numbers

According to the question,

19a + 19b = 342

⇒ a + b = 18

⇒ (1, 17), (5, 13), (7, 11)

**∴ 3 such pairs can be formed.**

questions.question: The average of three numbers is 180. If the third number is greater by 10 than {{1} over 3} of the first number and less by 5 than the second number, then the third number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of three numbers = 180

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of all Observations)/(Total Number of Observations)

**Calculation:**

Let first, second, and third numbers be a, b, and c

a + b + c = 540 ------(1)

According to the question,

⇒ (a × 1/3) + 10 = c 

⇒ a - 3c = - 30 ------(2)

Also, b - 5 = c

⇒ b - c = 5 ------(3)

Equation(1) - Equation(3)

⇒ a + 2c = 535 -------(4)

Equation(4) - Equation(2)

⇒ 5c = 565

⇒ c = 113

**∴ The third number is 113.**
